notes.title: Join our Discord community!
notes.content:
That's right, we’ve made ourselves a new discord channel!

You can join our server by following the link below:
https://discord.gg/F53J6aYHjJ

Discord will be the best place if you are interested in more consistent updates, asking us questions and even voting on kickstarter reward design options as and when we have them ready!

We look forward to seeing you there,

Luke, Ben and Thomas

notes.title: Join our mailing list!
notes.content:
[url=https://www.home-adventuregame.co.uk/][img]https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/d/1Ths3f58RZ9EIGN3JV1irwoTKaoQ71eTX[/img][/url]

[h1]Good news everyone![/h1] 

We now have a monthly newsletter we will be maintaining to keep those interested up to date with everything to do with Home.

And just for fun, we thought we'd throw in some free 4k wallpapers available in phone, desktop and ultra wide formats for all newcomers!

This newsletter really is the best way to stay up to date with how things are going, and to keep an eye out for key milestones like our kickstarter campaign, which we are working towards launching in the first quarter of 2025.

Subscribing to the mailing list can be done via our [url=https://www.home-adventuregame.co.uk/]website. [/url]

We hope to see you there!

Thank you,
Luke, Ben and Thomas.

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
[b]We've added some quality of life features to the demo![/b]

The most impactful change being the addition of the [b]hotspot finder[/b], this can be toggled on and off with the space bar. 

Skippable cutscenes now implemented as well as an animation to communicate when an autosave is being made.
